question.text: Will Vladimir Putin visit the United States in December 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as Yes if, after November 30, 2026 and before January 1, 2027, Russian President Vladimir Putin personally visits the United States, according to [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions).
question.fine_print:
"Personally visits" is defined as publicly reported to be physically present on the ground for any amount of time, including at an airport, within the national territory of the given country. Note that this excludes airspace, waters, embassies and consulates, and virtual appearances.

However, if this question would resolve differently than the original question, then this question will be annulled. # Will Putin visit the US in December 2026? Research notes

Overall: there is no confirmation that Putin will go. The Kremlin's latest on-record line (Nov 8) is that it is too early to say. Anonymous Kremlin sources quoted by Bloomberg in September said a Miami trip was "very slim" or "extremely remote." Markets price it at about 12%.

## 1. Resolution source
- There is no single data series. The question resolves on credible reports of Putin being physically on US soil between Dec 1 and Dec 31, 2026.
- The obvious occasion is the G20 leaders' summit on 14-15 December 2026 at Trump National Doral, Miami. Wikipedia lists Putin as an "expected participant," but that section is flagged as possibly speculative, and the page cites conflicting reports (Reuters, April: "may or may not attend"; Bloomberg: "plans to skip"). [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_G20_Miami_summit)
- I could not open the News24 background article (HTTP 404), so I could not check its date or how it sourced the claim that Putin "will travel to Florida." No other outlet I found confirms that claim.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The invitation is formal, but the Kremlin has not announced its delegation. Peskov has said Lavrov would lead it if Putin does not go. [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/09/23/kremlin-welcomes-u-s-invitation-for-putin-to-attend-december-g20-summit-in-miami)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-08: Peskov, asked whether Putin might accept after a possible Shenzhen meeting with Trump and Xi: "I wouldn't go that far. We know that such trips always entail significant logistical difficulties and challenges." [TASS](https://tass.com/politics/2214455)
- 2026-11-08: The head of Russia's human rights council (Fadeev) said Putin will meet the council in the first half of December. That does not directly conflict with Dec 14-15. [Life.ru](https://life.ru/p/putin-provedet-vstrechu-s-spch-v-pervoy-polovine-dekabrya)
- 2026-11-07: Deputy Foreign Minister Pankin said the US formally invited Russia, and Trump and Rubio want Putin there. Russia will be represented "at a high level," with the delegation decided just before the summit. [Vedomosti](https://www.vedomosti.ru/politics/news/2026/11/07/1243412-ssha-hoteli-bi-videt-putina), [Fontanka](https://www.fontanka.ru/2026/11/07/76751523/)
- 2026-11-03: The Kremlin said work is underway on a Putin-Trump-Xi meeting at APEC in Shenzhen (Nov 18-19). China has not confirmed Trump's part in it. [AA](https://aa.com.tr/en/world/work-underway-to-organize-trilateral-talks-between-putin-trump-xi-in-china-kremlin/4109707)
- 2026-09-24: Peskov said no decision had been taken on Miami. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/24/trump-invites-putin-to-miami-g20-why-that-matters)
- 2026-09-23: Rubio publicly invited Putin, and the Kremlin "welcomed" the invitation. [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/09/23/kremlin-welcomes-u-s-invitation-for-putin-to-attend-december-g20-summit-in-miami)
- ~2026-09-21: Bloomberg, citing Kremlin sources, reported Putin would attend APEC in China but is unlikely to go to Miami ("very slim prospect"). [ZeroHedge summary](https://www.zerohedge.com/geopolitical/putin-plans-skip-miami-g20-prioritizing-china-trip-kremlin-officials), [Liga](https://news.liga.net/en/politics/news/bloomberg-putin-is-likely-to-skip-the-g20-summit-in-the-us-but-plans-to-visit-china)
- 2026-09: Zelensky said he would meet Putin in the US if Putin attends. The Kremlin has dismissed the idea of a Zelensky meeting. [Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/09/12/kremlin-says-no-decision-yet-on-putins-g20-visit-dismisses-zelenskys-meeting-proposal-a93693)
- 2026-04: Peskov said Putin may go, may not, or another representative may go. [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/04/putin-may-or-may-not-attend-g20-miami-kremlin-says)
- 2026-03-11: Peskov said Putin was not expected to attend in person. [Caliber.az](https://caliber.az/en/post/putin-to-skip-g20-summit-in-miami-kremlin-confirms) (the page blocked me, so this is from the search summary)

## 4. Base rates
- Putin's US visits (from memory, not re-checked this session): 2000 and 2005 UN summits, 2001 Crawford, 2003 Camp David, 2007 Kennebunkport, 2015 UN General Assembly, and the 15 August 2025 Anchorage summit with Trump. That is about 8 visits in 26 years, and only one since 2015.
- He has not attended a G20 summit in person since Osaka 2019. He sent Lavrov or joined by video for 2020-2025.
- The US is not an ICC member, so the ICC warrant creates no arrest risk there. The Alaska trip showed he will travel to the US when there is a direct Trump meeting on offer.
- A December visit outside the G20 seems unlikely, since I found no reports of any other planned US trip.

## 5. Other forecasts (prices as of 2026-11-09)
- Polymarket, "Putin visits US by December 31, 2026?": 12.5% Yes. This is a near-exact match, though it would also count a November visit, which is very unlikely.
- Kalshi, Putin visits the US before Jan 1, 2027: 12%. Before Jul 1, 2027: 20%. Before Jan 1, 2028: 35%.
- Related markets: Trump, Xi and Putin meet before 2027 at 82% on Kalshi and 90% on Polymarket, mostly priced on Shenzhen APEC. Trump, Putin and Zelensky together before 2027 at 3.5-6%.
- I found no Metaculus community forecast or published expert forecasts.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Nov 18-19: APEC in Shenzhen, with a possible Trump-Putin bilateral or a Trump-Putin-Xi trilateral. If it happens, it could reduce Putin's need to go to Miami, or it could lead to an agreement that he will.
- Late November to early December: the Kremlin announces Russia's G20 delegation, which Pankin says usually happens on the eve of the summit.
- Ukraine peace talks: a breakthrough or a signing ceremony could pull Putin to the US. A breakdown makes a trip less likely.
- First half of December: Putin's human rights council meeting, plus his usual December schedule (year-end press conference, Federal Assembly-type events).
- Dec 14-15: the G20 summit in Miami, the main window for a Yes.

- Putin has made roughly one US visit in the past 10 years, which puts any given month at well under 5%.
